philosophy.text:
KARAKTER is an artist management company based in Berlin and London. Its philosophy is to work honestly and openly with our artists. We have a holistic approach to management, working with artists and producers with strong individual characters and finding the right path to represent them in the most appropriate way – whether that should be on a consultancy basis or full management basis.

As team-players, Karakter Worldwide also expects our artists and business partners to be team-players too. Good working relationships are a crucial foundation for a successful venture. Great music alone is not enough, because so many other things influence whether a career will be successful or not. We take a long-term view with our clients, building relationships and effective strategies to maximize our artists' potential for a long and healthy career.

Over the last ten years, Karakter artists have released many successful albums; were nominated for, or won, awards (Tony Awards, BBC Folk Awards, Grammy, Echo, Choice Music Prize, Meteor Awards, Deutscher Musikautorenpreis, Preis fuer Popkultur, Amadeus Awards among others); their music was chosen for movies, Netflix & television series and advertising campaigns; they've collaborated with respected film directors and created a Broadway musical; and played thousands of live shows and festivals worldwide.

team.text:
Karakter Management was established by three co-founders: Peter Putz, Liz Riches, and Maximilian Schenkel. Each brought extensive experience from different entertainment sectors.

The company was created in 2005 when the founders decided to combine their expertise. They had previously worked in publishing, labels, music television, film, publicity, lecturing about the music business at European and US universities and colleges, live booking and design.

In a time where this industry concentrates more and more on quantity and conveyor-belt short term success, we believe in focusing on the quality of our artists and of our own work.

The founding team has expanded to include additional staff members who align with their values and work approach. The company also provides consultation services and maintains strategic partnerships with various labels, publishers, distributors, and live promoters.

privacy_policy.text:
Karakter Management collects personal information when you subscribe to their newsletter. Typically, this comprises only your email address. For registrations prior to October 8th, 2016, they may retain your name, country, town, and/or postal code if provided.

This website is hosted on the Squarespace platform and your information is stored on secure servers behind a firewall.

Information is gathered exclusively for newsletter communications. The organization states they do not share subscriber details with external parties.

Subscribers can terminate their newsletter membership using the unsubscribe link included at the bottom of each message.

You may request to access your stored data, correct incomplete or inaccurate information, or request deletion of your personal data by contacting the organization via email. Karakter Management may ask for identifying information before processing access requests to ensure legitimate requests.

This privacy policy only applies to Karakter Worldwide. External websites linked from their site operate under separate policies.

The site is not designed for minors, and they do not intentionally gather information about children.
